```{r setup}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "setup_dashboard.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: inject-bio-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (bio_ready) {
  bio_for_js <- bio_data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      code   = code_commune,
      surf   = round(bio_surface_ha, 1),
      ab     = round(bio_surface_ab, 1),
      nex    = bio_n_exploit,
      nop    = bio_n_operateurs
    )
  emit_table("bioData", bio_for_js)
  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.bioPalette = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(PAL$green)), ';\n',
      'window.bioFields = ', '{"bio_surface_ha": {"key": "surf", "title": "Surface bio, ha (échelle log)", "unit": "ha", "digits": 0, "scale": "log_quantile", "na": "Aucune surface bio déclarée"}, "bio_n_operateurs": {"key": "nop", "title": "Opérateurs bio (échelle log)", "unit": "", "digits": 0, "scale": "log_quantile", "na": "Aucun opérateur"}, "bio_n_exploit": {"key": "nex", "title": "Exploitations bio (échelle log)", "unit": "", "digits": 0, "scale": "log_quantile", "na": "Aucune exploitation"}}', ';\n',
      'window.bioRecolor = function(field) {\n',
      '  var f = window.bioFields[field];\n',
      '  CMap.recolor({ get: function (c) { var r = window.bioData[c]; return r ? r[f.key] : null; },\n',
      '    scale: f.scale, palette: window.bioPalette,\n',
      '    legend: { title: f.title, unit: f.unit, digits: f.digits, naLabel: f.na } });\n',
      '};\n',
      'window.updateBioPanel = function(code) {\n',
      '  var el = document.getElementById("bio-content");\n',
      '  if (!el) return;\n',
      '  var d = window.bioData[code];\n',
      '  var elec = window.communeLookup && window.communeLookup[code];\n',
      '  var alt  = window.communeNames && window.communeNames[code];\n',
      '  var nom  = elec ? elec.nom_commune : (alt ? alt.nom : code);\n',
      '  var dept = elec ? (elec.libelle_dept + " (" + elec.code_dept + ")") : (alt ? ("Dépt " + alt.dept) : "");\n',
      '  if (!d) { el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div><div class="dvf-empty">Pas de surface bio certifiée publiée.</div>\'; return; }\n',
      '  function fmt(x) { return (x == null) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", {maximumFractionDigits:1}); }\n',
      '  el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Agriculture biologique (Agence Bio 2024)</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Surface bio totale</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.surf) + \' ha</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Surface certifiée AB</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.ab) + \' ha</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Nb exploitations</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.nex) + \'</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Nb opérateurs</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.nop) + \'</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'</div></div>\';\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

<div class="dvf-controls">
  <div class="dvf-ctrl-group">

    <div class="dvf-ctrl-radios" id="bio-radios">
      <label><input type="radio" name="bio-ind" value="bio_surface_ha" checked> Surface bio (ha)</label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="bio-ind" value="bio_n_operateurs"> Nb opérateurs</label>

```{r}
#| label: map-bio
if (bio_ready) {
  vals0 <- bio_data |> dplyr::transmute(code_commune, value = bio_surface_ha)
  st_bio <- cmap_breaks(vals0$value[vals0$code_commune %in% com_metro_only$code], "log_quantile")
  m <- cmap_choropleth(com_metro_only, dep_metro, vals0, palette = PAL$green,
                       legend_title = "Surface bio, ha (échelle log)", unit = "ha", digits = 0L,
                       scale = "log_quantile", breaks = st_bio, na_label = "Aucune surface bio déclarée")
  cmap_on_render(m, cmap_page_hooks(
    "bio", "updateBioPanel", "bio-content", "bio-ind", "bioRecolor", "bio_surface_ha",
    ctx = list(ctx_spec("bio_surface_ha", "Surface bio", "ha", 0L), ctx_spec("bio_n_operateurs", "Opérateurs bio", "", 0L),
               ctx_spec("bio_n_exploit", "Exploitations bio", "", 0L))))
} else {
  htmltools::HTML("<p class='js-loading'>Agence Bio non chargé.</p>")
}
```
:::

</div>
